name: WMUIServerDrivenView
description: Renders a screen described in JSON, in the format of Vercel's json-render, through a fixed catalog of React Native components. Bind the spec to a variable to serve each user, role or store section its own UI without shipping a new build. Props read bound variables with $data, inputs write local state with $bindState, and buttons fire custom actions the page handles in On Action.

spec.name: spec
spec.description: The screen to render: { root, elements } with each element { type, props, children, visible, on, repeat }, a nested { type, props, children } tree, or either as a JSON string. Bind it to a variable whose dataSet is the spec, e.g. a service variable that returns the screen for the user's section. Example: {root: 'title', elements: {title: {type: 'Heading', props: {text: {$data: '/user/name'}}}}}

data.name: data
data.description: Variables the spec reads with {$data: '/path'} — a variable's dataSet, or an object combining several, e.g. {user: Variables.user.dataSet, orders: Variables.orders}. Read-only from the spec; changes re-render live, and spec state seeded from $data fills in when the variable loads.

accentColor.name: accentColor
accentColor.description: Primary color of the built-in buttons, switches, checkboxes, steppers and progress bars. Default: #2563EB

onAction.name: onAction
onAction.description: Fires when an element runs a custom action, e.g. on: {press: {action: 'submitSweep', params: {...}}}. The event carries action, params (resolved), item and index (inside a repeat), elementKey and the local state. Switch on event.action and invoke only the variables you expect.

onStateChange.name: onStateChange
onStateChange.description: Fires after every write to local state — an input edit, a setState, pushState or removeState action — with statePath, value and the whole state. Use it to copy edits back into a variable.
